The '''''Dauntless Star''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] of [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] design.

==Description==
It was considered a beautiful ship and a classic Mon Cal design by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vujaar]] at the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]]. The ship was fitted with several cannons.

==History==
The cruiser fought at the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]] where it shot down over 60 Imperial fighters. It was eventually defeated and crashed onto the surface of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].
